factions.name: United Federation of Planets

signature.desc: Integrate other species via diplomacy; each member grants a unique bonus (Vulcan: research, Andorian: military, Tellarite: engineering, Bajoran: faith/morale).

factions.weakness: Ships expensive; slow to declare war (council vote).

factions.name: Klingon Empire

signature.desc: Earn Honor from combat and victories; spend it to call on Great Houses for ships, or lose it and risk civil war.

factions.weakness: Weak economy and research; dishonorable acts (fleeing, sneak attacks on allies) cost Honor.
factions.home: Qo'noS (Praxis moon — can explode in TOS era)

factions.name: Romulan Star Empire

signature.desc: Espionage ops: steal tech, incite unrest, assassinate captains. Cloaks on almost every hull.

factions.weakness: Singularity-core ships leave gravity wells when destroyed; paranoid internal politics.

factions.name: Cardassian Union

signature.desc: Conquered colonies produce +50% but generate Resistance; ore-processing stations double refined output.

factions.weakness: Resistance cells; ships individually weaker than Federation equivalents.

factions.name: The Dominion

signature.desc: Jem'Hadar are cheap and fearless but need White; supply cut-off makes them go feral.

factions.weakness: Dependent on White and on a wormhole/supply link to the Gamma Quadrant.

factions.name: Ferengi Alliance

signature.desc: Unlockable Rules grant economic perks; can buy foreign ships, modules and mercenaries with Latinum.

factions.weakness: Weak native military; Latinum loss cripples them.

factions.name: Borg Collective

signature.desc: Shields adapt to weapon types used repeatedly against the Collective; assimilate ships, tech and population.

factions.weakness: Can't trade or ally; frequency-rotation and multi-weapon strategies counter adaptation.

signature.desc: Weapon that knocks out a target's power entirely.
Ships cooperate to spin an energy web that traps enemies.
Durable, slow, heavy-hitting ships.
Wormhole aliens may intervene; resistance cells fight occupiers.

factions.name: United Earth (pre-Federation)
factions.weakness: Small, under-gunned fleet; no reliable transporters or deflector shields early.

signature.desc: Found the Coalition of Planets with Vulcans/Andorians/Tellarites — becomes the Federation in an Ages campaign.

factions.name: Vulcan High Command
factions.weakness: Slow to fight and slow to share tech; bound by High Command caution.

signature.desc: Research and sensor bonuses; mind-meld intel; reluctant to fight.

factions.name: Andorian Empire
factions.weakness: Hot-tempered diplomacy; feuds with Vulcans and Tellarites waste effort.

signature.desc: Strong early military; ice-world colonization bonus.
Cheaper construction; trade bonuses; argumentative diplomacy.

factions.name: Starfleet (Stranded Ship)
factions.weakness: No homeworld, no supply range and no reinforcements from home.
factions.home: None: a single starship far from home

signature.desc: Start with one ship, no homeworld; trade, scavenge and recruit to build a fleet.
Raids crews for organs to fight the Phage; medicine-tech leaders.

factions.name: Romulan Free State
factions.weakness: No homeworld after the supernova; split loyalties and synth paranoia.

signature.desc: Post-supernova; scattered colonies, refugee manpower, Zhat Vash intrigue.
Anti-pirate vigilantes; bounty-hunting bonuses.

factions.name: Federation (Post-Burn)
factions.weakness: Almost no dilithium; a shrunken fleet stretched across a scattered union.

signature.desc: Reconnect lost member worlds; programmable-matter ships; dilithium-starved.

factions.name: Emerald Chain
factions.weakness: Rule by fear: subjects revolt and rivals betray when the Chain looks weak.

signature.desc: Orion-Andorian crime syndicate controlling dilithium supply.
Unified Vulcan-Romulan world; cloaks plus research bonuses.
Rises from unhappy or ceded colonies; guerrilla raids from plasma storms.
Raids trade lanes, sells contraband, kidnaps colonists.
Hit-and-run attacks on freighters and civilian transports.
Many feuding sects; swarm tactics; covet replicator tech.
Target your highest-XP ships/captains; tetryon weapons.
Bio-ships immune to most weapons; only nanoprobe-based weapons work well.
